headlines.title: Boris Nadezhdin, anti-war candidate in Russia, flees to France
headlines.summary: Nadezhdin was prohibited from running in parliamentary elections in September. He posted a video from Paris, saying, "I'm alive and free."

headlines.title: Iran rejects Trump’s claim that talks will restart, adding to weekend of whiplash
headlines.summary: The U.S. president said late Sunday that he had called off “the biggest attack since WWII” so that talks could resume. Iran said Monday that no talks were planned.

headlines.title: Labour overtakes Trump-aligned Reform UK in national polls
headlines.summary: New British Prime Minister Andy Burnham’s Labour Party has pulled ahead of the Trump-aligned, anti-immigrant Reform UK party for the first time in more than a year.

headlines.title: Loomer’s Ukraine reversal deepens split in Trump’s ‘America First’ movement
headlines.summary: Influential MAGA blogger and former Kyiv critic Laura Loomer expects to visit the president to advocate for the U.S.-Ukraine alliance.

headlines.title: As Chipotle opens in Mexico, one skeptic says ‘It’s gringo food for gringos’
headlines.summary: The U.S. fast-food chain says it can succeed south of the border, where Taco Bell has tried and failed twice. Some customers are embracing it — as American cuisine.

headlines.title: Colombia’s Petro repeats vote fraud claims days before handing over power
headlines.summary: Petro accuses programmers of altering vote counts and claims metadata tied to election results was hidden from review.

headlines.title: Salvadoran man dies in ICE custody at New Jersey detention centre
headlines.summary: Second Delaney Hall detainee death in eight months prompts calls to close facility, demands for answers.

headlines.title: Ibrahim Traore: Why Burkina Faso’s popular leader faces a reality test
headlines.summary: Traore’s sovereignty message has won support across Africa, but his record at home faces scrutiny.

headlines.title: Board of Peace says no Israeli withdrawal from Gaza before Hamas disarms
headlines.summary: Netanyahu and board director Maldenov meet amid tensions over Gaza disarmament roadmap and recent Israeli attacks.

headlines.title: Trump administration sued by 25 states over new tariffs on trading partners
headlines.summary: The states claim the new levies are a pretext to re-impose tariffs that were ruled illegal by the US Supreme Court.

headlines.title: These are some of the last pristine ocean ecosystems. Now, they're losing protections
headlines.summary: The largest conservation areas in the U.S. are in the Pacific Ocean, where tiny islands are epicenters of biodiversity. The Trump administration is now opening their waters to commercial fishing, sparking a battle over some of the country's most pristine ecosystems.

headlines.title: House Ethics panel recommends censure for Chuck Edwards after harassment allegations
headlines.summary: After a months-long investigation, the ethics committee recommended censure for Edwards because of "persistent unprofessional and inappropriate conduct towards two young female staffers."

headlines.title: Ripple effects: Three people have Reflecting Pool charges dropped after Hearn request
headlines.summary: Federal prosecutors moved to drop their case against David Hearn, blaming Reflecting Pool damage on a "botched installation" rather than vandalism. That has implications for others who were charged.

headlines.title: With U.S. doors shutting, Cubans turn to Brazil for asylum
headlines.summary: For years, many Cubans hoping to leave the island looked to the United States. Now, with legal pathways largely closed, a growing number are heading to Brazil instead.

headlines.title: Photos: Wildfires in Spokane lead to thousands of evacuations
headlines.summary: Wildfires in Spokane have destroyed hundreds of homes and led to evacuation orders for 60,000 people.

headlines.title: Collision of helicopters leaves 2 dead in Greece
headlines.summary: AGIOS KONSTANTINOS — Five water-dropping planes and another five helicopters took off at first light on Monday to help hundreds of firefighters battling a major wildfire west of Athens, Greece, a day after a midair collision between two firefighting helicopters killed two crew members.

headlines.title: UK's AstraZeneca eyeing $400b merger, report says
headlines.summary: The United Kingdom's second-most valuable listed company, pharmaceutical firm AstraZeneca, has been revealed to have been holding talks for some time with United States-based rival Bristol Myers Squibb, or BMS, about a merger, which could result in a global pharma giant worth nearly $400 billion.

headlines.title: Iran urges US to uphold MoU
headlines.summary: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian urged Washington to remain committed to the memorandum of understanding, or MoU, signed with Iran in June, as US President Donald Trump claimed that talks would resume on Monday after he held off fresh strikes against Tehran.

headlines.title: Israel voices concern over Hamas disarmament deal
headlines.summary: TEL AVIV/GAZA — Israel has shared "serious security concerns" with the White House regarding the proposed disarmament deal with Hamas, an Israeli official said as Israeli strikes overnight and into Sunday evening killed at least 18 people, including children, in Gaza.

headlines.title: Tariffs risk deepening trade fragmentation across globe
headlines.summary: As a new wave of sweeping US tariffs took effect, experts warn that Washington's tariff policy is becoming increasingly institutionalized, a shift that risks deepening the fragmentation of global trade and causing lasting damage to both the US and world economies.

headlines.title: Several WhatsApp users say their accounts 'put under review'
headlines.summary: WhatsApp users report accounts under review for 24 hours, causing widespread disruption and frustration among affected individuals.

headlines.title: Lok Sabha passes Supreme Court judges Bill without debate as Opposition protests continue
headlines.summary: Lok Sabha passes Supreme Court judges' bill without debate amid opposition protests over NEET leaks and Ram temple donations.

headlines.title: Amid Opposition protests, Rajya Sabha passes MSME Bill
headlines.summary: Rajya Sabha passes the MSME Bill amid Opposition protests, establishing a digital platform for voluntary registration of enterprises.

headlines.title: Pappu Yadav’s ‘seer’ skit puts SP in a bind; party leader terms it ‘incorrect act’
headlines.summary: Pappu Yadav's controversial skit in Parliament draws criticism, causing tension within the Samajwadi Party amid ongoing Ram Temple donation protests.

headlines.title: Parliament Monsoon Session Day 12 LIVE: FM Sitharaman to introduce Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill
headlines.summary: Parliament Monsoon Session 2026 | Follow The Hindu's LIVE updates for the latest proceedings in the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha on August 4, 2026.

hackerNews.title: LLMs reward expertise
hackerNews.summary: In the 2010s, if you had technical gaps (say, you couldn’t write CSS), you had to either rely on a skilled colleague or just hope that the answer to your exact problem was out there on the internet. Today, everyone can write sort-of-okay CSS by delegating the task to an LLM. LLMs make everybody into a generalist.
